projects.name: Markets Regulatory Reporting Automation
details: Key Responsibilities
• Working as Senior Business Analyst supporting Global Markets Regulatory Reporting transformation
and automation initiatives.
• Conducting requirement gathering workshops with Regulatory Reporting SMEs, Operations, Risk,
Data Governance and Technology teams.
• Preparing Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), User
Stories, Process Flows, Data Mapping Documents and Impact Assessment reports.
• Creating end-to-end data flow diagrams for regulatory reports by identifying source systems,
upstream/downstream dependencies, data refineries, transformation layers and reporting platforms.
• Performing detailed analysis of regulatory reporting processes to identify automation opportunities,
process gaps, control weaknesses and data quality issues.
• Collaborating with business and technology teams to define future-state reporting processes and
automated reporting solutions.
• Supporting change management and business readiness activities including stakeholder
communications, governance updates and implementation planning.
• Managing RAID logs, requirement traceability, action trackers and governance reporting.
• Coordinating SIT, UAT, defect management, release readiness and post-production support activities.
• Preparing executive-level governance packs, project status reports, risk assessments and progress
updates for senior leadership.
• Supporting strategic automation initiatives to improve reporting accuracy, operational efficiency and
regulatory compliance across Global Markets functions.
